lemmas.primary_translation: an unspecified number; quite a few or a lot

definitions.translation: quite a large number or amount

examples.no: selskapet må si opp x antall ansatte for å unngå konkurs
examples.en: the company has to lay off a number of employees to avoid bankruptcy

examples.no: hver dag får vi x antall henvendelser om det samme
examples.en: every day we receive a number of inquiries about the same thing
